innovative solution integrates Python for backend development and Streamlit for an intuitive user interface, displaying generated
posts in both English and Hinglish (a blend of Hindi and English).
1. Data Collection & Preprocessing:
o collect 100 to 200 posts from top LinkedIn influencers.
o The data undergoes preprocessing to clean and structure it for model training.
2. Fine-Tuning & Post Generation:
o The Llama-3.1-8B-Instant model is fine-tuned on the influencer's writing style.
o It generates new LinkedIn posts that closely match the influencer’s tone and style.
o Posts can be generated in English and Hinglish (a mix of Hindi & English).
3. User Interface with Streamlit:
o The generated posts are displayed on an intuitive Streamlit-based UI.
o Users can review, edit, and refine the AI-generated content before posting.
